free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the PI-RADS score of 4, which is above the EAU threshold of 3, strongly supports sampling. This decision is further reinforced by the significant PSA velocity of 2.79 ng/mL/yr and the cohort consensus that mandates biopsy in this scenario. The evidence converged on this recommendation, as the retrieved PI-RADS score and PSA velocity were the decisive factors.
